existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: R6 `Goal` has hard local R4-to-R6 breaks because several R4 element names were removed or replaced. Top migration concerns are preserving outcomes, interpreting status dates/reasons, and separating old `expressedBy` into R6 `source` and possibly `recorder`. The biggest uncertainty is the absence of official cross-version mapping guidance.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration should not rely on simple same-name copying. R4 instances containing `statusReason`, `statusDate`, `expressedBy`, `outcomeCode`, or `outcomeReference` need transforms before R6 validation. R6 instances using `acceptance`, `continuous`, `lifecycleStatus=unknown`, new `addresses` target resources, or source/recorder patterns cannot be losslessly represented in plain R4 without extensions or external resources.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for structural, cardinality, type, reference target, binding, and flag deltas because they are directly visible in the local StructureDefinitions. Confidence is medium for the intended semantic mapping of removed/replaced elements because no official diff, narrative rationale, or cross-version ConceptMap was supplied.

compatibilityLeverage.note: Resource-level leverage is a planning signal. It does not mark individual Revisit findings as justified or unimportant.

rationaleMd:
Goal keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 4 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 0 potential hard break(s), 3 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 0 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 2, which creates neutral stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 56/100, producing migration shape `moderate-targeted-remodel`, major migration `Partial`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

2 finding(s) identify a yes/partial less-breaking base-design alternative, so the aggregate should not be used to dismiss local avoidability review.

11 shared Resource/DomainResource behavior finding(s) are listed as context but not scored for this resource to avoid duplicating base behavior issues across all resources.
recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.

topFindings.title: Goal outcomeCode and outcomeReference were removed without a direct R6 Goal replacement
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid and R6-to-R4 loss: R4 outcome elements are unknown in R6, and migration may require Observation linkage, extensions, notes, or profile-specific decisions rather than a base element.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Goal.statusDate was replaced by achievementStatusDate with narrower semantics
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid plus semantic/documentation: R4 statusDate is an unknown R6 property, and mapping it to achievementStatusDate can misstate lifecycle events as achievement-status dates.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Goal.expressedBy was replaced by source and a new recorder element
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid and runtime/API/codegen: R4 instances with expressedBy fail R6 validation and generated clients must rename source attribution logic; R6-to-R4 can also lose recorder or new source target detail.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Goal.statusReason was replaced by repeating CodeableConcept lifecycleStatusReason
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid and runtime/API/codegen: R4 instances with statusReason fail strict R6 validation, and SDKs change from one string property to a repeating CodeableConcept property.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R6 adds a structured Goal.acceptance backbone with required participant when present
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: none for R4-to-R6; R6-to-R4 loss only if new acceptance content is populated and a plain R4 representation is required.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: Goal.lifecycleStatus required value set adds the R6-only code unknown
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: R6-to-R4 loss: an R6 instance using lifecycleStatus=unknown cannot be represented by R4's required binding, but all R4 lifecycle-status values remain acceptable in R6.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.
